reasoning_content:
Okay, so I need to make it so the dev user can use ddev. The ddev binary is in /home/dev/ddev, but it's better to install it into the user's PATH. Also, ddev needs to be configured so it works as a non-root user.

Since dev belongs to the docker group, it should be able to access docker.sock. However, the group membership needs to be reflected — since it's a new shell, it should be fine.

Let me set up the ddev binary for the dev user and test it.

action.command: mkdir -p /home/dev/.local/bin && cp /tmp/ddev /home/dev/.local/bin/ddev && chmod +x /home/dev/.local/bin/ddev && chown dev:dev /home/dev/.local/bin/ddev && echo 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH' >> /home/dev/.bashrc && su - dev -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && ddev version' 2>&1 | head -20
